title: TotalSeq™-A Antibodies and Cell Hashing with 10x Single Cell 3' Reagent Kit v3 3.1 Protocol
author: Sam Li
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8aahsae
materials: If using biotinylated antibodies, incubate with the appropriate oligo barcoded streptavidin at the recommended amount specified in the product technical datasheet for 20 minutes.
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Prepare Cell Suspension
steps.instruction: Prepare a single cell suspension and resuspend cells at a concentration of 2x10^7 cells/mL in staining buffer.

substeps.instruction: Verify cell viability is >95% (include dead cells in total count).
Perform live cell enrichment (e.g., via Flow Cytometry) if high cell death is observed.

steps.title: Block Cells
steps.instruction: Aliquot 50 µl of cells into 12 x 75mm tubes and add blocking reagent.

substeps.instruction: Add either 5 µl of Human TruStain FcX™ Fc or 0.5 µl of TruStain FcX™ PLUS (anti-mouse CD16/32) Blocking reagent.
Incubate for 10 min at 4°C.

steps.title: Prepare Antibody Pool
steps.instruction: While cells are incubating in Fc Block, prepare the antibody pool.

substeps.instruction: Combine 1 µg (or titrated amounts) of each TotalSeq™ or Biotinylated antibody.
If the cocktail volume is less than 50 µl, add Cell Staining Buffer to reach 50 µl.
Centrifuge the pool at 14,000xg at 2–8°C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Stain Cells
steps.instruction: Apply the antibody cocktail to the cells and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Carefully pipette out the liquid from the cell tubes, avoiding the bottom.
Add the TotalSeq™ antibody cocktail to the cell suspension.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the stained cells three times.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL of cell staining buffer.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 350g at 4°C.
Repeat this wash process 2 more times (3 washes total).

steps.title: Filter and Dilute Cells
steps.instruction: Prepare cells for the 10X Chromium controller.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 500 µL of PBS to achieve a concentration of 1x10^6 cells/mL.
Filter cells through a 40 µm Flowmi™ Cell Strainer.
Verify cell concentration using a hemocytometer after filtration.
Dilute cells as necessary for appropriate input into the 10X Chromium controller.

steps.title: Perform 10x Genomics Assay
steps.instruction: Run the 10x Genomics single cell 3' v3 assay following document CG000185, Rev B.

substeps.instruction: Proceed through Post Gem-RT Cleanup – Dynabeads (step 2.1).
At the cDNA amplification step (Step 2.2), use the provided table.
Follow steps 2.3A and 2.3B exactly to separate ADTs/HTOs from cDNA, using 70 µL of sparQ or SPRI beads in step 2.3B.

steps.title: Prepare Sample Index PCR Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the PCR mix for ADT and HTO libraries.

substeps.instruction: For samples containing both ADT and HTO, perform two separate reactions.
Add 5 µl of 'purified ADT/HTO fraction' from the same sample to the respective ADT or HTO reaction.
Incubate in a thermal cycler using the specified ADT/HTO protocols.

steps.title: Purify Libraries
steps.instruction: Clean up the libraries using magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 120 µl sparQ or SPRIselect Reagent (1.2X) to each sample.
Incubate 5 min at room temperature.
Place on the magnet in the High position until the solution clears.
Wash the pellet twice with 200 µl 80% ethanol while the tubes are on the magnet in the High position.
Centrifuge briefly, place on the magnet in the Low position, and remove remaining ethanol.
Remove from the magnet and add 40.5 µl water.
Incubate 2 min at room temperature.
Place on the magnet in the Low position until the solution clears.
Transfer 40 µl to a new tube strip.

steps.title: Store and Quantify Libraries
steps.instruction: Store the purified libraries and verify quality.

substeps.instruction: Store at 4°C for up to 72 h or at −20°C for long-term storage.
Quantify libraries using standard methods (QuBit, BioAnalyzer, qPCR).
Note that ADT libraries should be approximately 180 bp.

steps.title: Sequence Libraries
steps.instruction: Sequence the CITE-seq libraries, pooling ADT and mRNA cDNA libraries.

substeps.instruction: Target an average of 100 molecules per ADT per cell.
Typically sequence ADT libraries in 5-10% of a lane and cDNA library fraction at 90% of a lane (e.g., HiSeq2500 Rapid Run Mode Flowcell), aiming for approximately 5k reads/cell for ADTs.
